county_relationship.note: Counties derived from the county on each facility's source record. A ZIP can span several counties; HUD USPS crosswalk not yet configured.

top_violation_types.title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Upon reviewing children files, one child did not have a health statement on file.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have a copy of their educational documents on file for review.

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operations classrooms are out of ratio at times.

top_violation_types.title: Required Posting of Emergency Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §747.403(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have the emergency telephone numbers posted.

top_violation_types.title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation does not have written policy for procedures for the release of children, illness and exclusion criteria, procedures for dispensing medication a statement that medication is not dispensed, procedures for handling medical emergencies, discipline and guidance policy, safe sleep for infant 12 months old or younger, the procedures for parents to visit the child-care home any time during your hours of operation to observe their child, program activities, the home, the premises, and equipment without having to secure prior approval, the procedures for parents to review copy of the child-care home's most recent Licensing inspection report and how the parent may access the minimum standards online, instructions on how a parent may contact the local Licensing office, access the Texas Abuse and Neglect Hotline, and access the DFPS website your emergency preparedness plan, procedures for conducting health checks.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed sleeping in a restrictive device.
